searchText: Hi fellow consensus-devs, what's the best link to see current consensus nodes stats, i.e. how much percentage do each implementation have deployments? The best one I'm aware of right now is https://clientdiversity.org/ ... you can also run the blockprint crawler yourself via https://github.com/sigp/blockprint/
